pages.title: A controlled model comparison
pages.text:
A controlled model comparison
Both classiﬁers receive the same feature representation and the same training rows.
The
held-out comparison measures the consequences of the ﬁtted functions, not diﬀerences in
which test observations were selected.

pages.title: Reproducibility and variability
pages.text:
Reproducibility and variability
A ﬁxed seed reproduces one random split and initialization.
It does not quantify variation
over other samples. Repeated, properly separated experiments are needed to study that
variation.
